sth.definition: n a hormone produced by the anterior pituitary gland; promotes growth in humans

sth in the wind.translation: 秘密之事将要发生, 秘密地在进行

sthene.definition: n a unit of force equal to 1000 newtons
sthene.translation: 斯亭(力单位, =1000牛顿或10达因)

sthenic.definition:
a. Strong; active; -- said especially of morbid states
   attended with excessive action of the heart and blood vessels, and
   characterized by strength and activity of the muscular and nervous
   system; as, a sthenic fever.
sthenic.translation:
a. 精力旺盛的, 亢进性的, 兴奋的
[医] 强壮的, 有力的

sthenic fever.translation: [医] 实热, 强壮性发热

stheno.translation: [网络] 丝西娜；斯忒诺；力量
